records.title: Preparing Quantum Backflow States by Large Momentum Transfer
records.read_status: Official latest metadata, full HTML and the PDF conclusion read; selected model and numerical-result passages inspected.
source_locations: HTML Section III.4, integrated probability transfer and density-signature distinction
HTML Introduction, distinction from general-backflow framework
records.verified_result: A theoretical noninteracting Sr-88 BEC LMT preparation protocol provides tunable two-arm interference states. It is a proposal with simulations, not a reported matter-wave backflow observation. The v2 reports an example integrated backflow transfer 0.003514 and explicitly distinguishes this from enhancement of the density-based signature.
records.explicit_future_work: Adapt the LMT preparation strategy to the general-backflow framework for arbitrary realistic wave packets and use fluorescence or absorption density measurements at multiple distinct evolution times.
records.practical_unresolved_issue: Stronger backflow comes with a shorter density-modulation scale, making conventional imaging harder.
records.short_quote: adapted to the more general-backflow framework for realistic wave packets
records.version_warning: The v1 conclusion said alternative density extraction was beyond scope. The latest v2 instead states the more specific general-backflow/multiple-time-imaging direction; use v2 for author-intent claims.
records.relation_to_parent_task: This is a concrete author-stated open measurement route. A cosine-lattice finite-resolution witness test is a proposed transfer of the question, not a result already established in this cold-atom paper.

records.title: Nonlocal Manipulation of Backflow with Quantum Correlations
records.read_status: Official metadata and Sections 1, 3, 4 and Appendix A read. No journal publication metadata was found on the official abstract page.
source_locations: PDF pp.8-9, Section 4 Conclusion and Discussion
HTML Section 3, weak transverse-momentum measurements and reconstructed trajectories
HTML Appendix A, mixed-state current and purity thresholds
records.verified_result: The preprint reports experimental nonlocal manipulation of transverse backflow in entangled-photon double-slit interference. Conditional amplitude and phase choices alter currents; Werner-state studies quantify correlation thresholds.
records.scope_boundary: This is quantum-optical transverse probability-current manipulation. It does not establish a direct longitudinal matter-wave realization of homogeneous tight-binding Gaussian backflow.
explicit_future_work: Extend the scheme to multidimensional motion and multiparticle systems.
Develop applications in particle manipulation and imaging.
Clarify the fundamental connection between quantum correlations and backflow.
records.relation_to_parent_task: It is no longer safe to repeat an unqualified claim that every form of backflow is experimentally unobserved. Optical analogues and single-photon variants must be separated from the matter-wave/tight-binding claim.
records.caution: The paper's future relativistic wording is not used here as a recommendation; the current lattice task has no relativistic model.

records.title: Different routes to the classical limit of backflow
records.read_status: Official abstract inspected; not full-text-assessed in this branch.
records.verified_abstract_claim: The paper studies intrinsic decoherence, Lindblad comparison and dissipative backflow routes; it emphasizes that thermal fluctuations can violate a maintained positive-momentum requirement.
records.relation_to_parent_task: Noise/decoherence of backflow is not a wholly new general direction. A proposed lattice test must define the classical comparator and track velocity-sector contamination; negative current alone under scattering or heating is insufficient.

records.title: Simulating quantum backflow on a quantum computer
records.read_status: Official abstract and version/publication metadata inspected.
records.verified_abstract_claim: Reports a backflow simulation using a real quantum computer.
records.relation_to_parent_task: Quantum-hardware emulation already exists; a small local numerical demo alone is a verification artifact, not evidence for first realization or a new effect.
